epicDescription: This epic enables fully automated setup of Maven builds by fetching the required wrapper file during bootstrap without manual steps. It reads project settings to find or default the download location, downloads the file efficiently, and supports secure access to protected repositories. The result is predictable, consistent builds for developers and CI.

frontend.functional_requirements: Provide a user interface for Maven build configuration management, allowing developers to view and configure wrapper download settings, monitor build status, and access build logs through a web dashboard.
frontend.technical_requirements: Implement a React-based dashboard with TypeScript for type safety. Use Material-UI for consistent styling and components. Integrate with backend APIs to display build configurations, download status, and error logs. Implement real-time updates using WebSocket connections for build status monitoring.
frontend.devops_requirements: Set up CI/CD pipeline for the frontend application using GitHub Actions. Containerize the React application using Docker and deploy to Kubernetes cluster. Implement automated testing including unit tests with Jest and end-to-end tests with Cypress. Configure monitoring with application performance monitoring tools.

stories.description: Build a responsive dashboard interface that allows developers to view and configure Maven wrapper download settings including URL configuration, authentication settings, and download location preferences.
Create real-time monitoring interface to display Maven build status, download progress, and error notifications with WebSocket integration for live updates.

backend.functional_requirements: Provide robust APIs for Maven wrapper bootstrap automation including configuration management, secure download orchestration, authentication handling, and build status tracking. Support configuration discovery, fallback mechanisms, secure authenticated downloads, efficient caching, and integrity verification.
backend.technical_requirements: Develop microservices using Spring Boot with Java 11+. Implement secure HTTPS-only downloads with TLS 1.2+ support. Use Redis for caching downloaded artifacts and configuration settings. Implement JWT-based authentication for API access. Support retry mechanisms with exponential backoff for downloads. Include checksum/signature verification for artifact integrity. Provide comprehensive logging without exposing secrets.
backend.devops_requirements: Automate build, test, and deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions. Containerize all services with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes using Helm charts. Implement comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana including metrics for download success rates, authentication failures, and API performance. Set up alerting for critical failures and security events. Configure distributed tracing for request tracking across services.

stories.summary: Bootstrap auto-download of Maven Wrapper with config-driven location and secure access
stories.description: Implements a bootstrap mechanism that auto-fetches the Maven Wrapper based on project settings with a secure, authenticated, and cache-optimized download, ensuring zero-setup, predictable builds for developers and CI.

stories.summary: Implement configuration discovery and fallback API
stories.description: Create REST endpoint to handle configuration discovery from project settings with documented default fallback URLs. Support cross-platform compatibility (Linux, macOS, Windows, CI) with proper logging that excludes secrets.

Build secure download service that supports protected repositories using Maven settings or environment variables for authentication. Ensure HTTPS-only with TLS 1.2+ and provide clear error messages for misconfigurations.

stories.summary: Implement efficient download with caching and verification
stories.description: Create download service with retry/backoff mechanisms, resumable downloads, local caching, and mandatory checksum/signature verification. Handle integrity failures with explicit error reporting.

stories.summary: Create build status and monitoring APIs
stories.description: Develop APIs for tracking build status, download progress, and error reporting. Include WebSocket support for real-time updates and comprehensive logging for troubleshooting.
